title: Online Community and Connection in America
summary: Nearly four-in-ten U.S. adults are in an online community. These virtual third spaces can take many forms, like Facebook groups, online video games or fandom forums on Reddit.

summary: Since 2019, a growing share among those who say there’s too much inequality think the economic system needs to be completely rebuilt to address it.
